title: Technician Pale-6's chain at Node Beta, once per pilot: Conductive Lattice (5,500 cr, 20 silver ore from Ironlight Crossroads), Resonance Substrate (7,000 cr, 15 energy crystal from Central Nexus), Final Calibration (8,000 cr, 5 circuit boards handed out, delivered to Node Gamma)
note: Flown by hand 2026-11-15 23:33 to 2026-11-16 00:12 UTC by one trader, one mission after the other. (1) Conductive Lattice: the accept hands out no silver; 20 silver ore bought at Ironlight Crossroads (LHS 1140, lawless, six jumps) for 3,040 cr (152 cr each, no tax there; 200 at that price in the census book of 23:21 UTC, 180 after our buy); handed in at the Node Beta redock, +5,500 cr; RESULT +2,312 cr after the silver and 148 cr of fuel, 21.5 min. (2) Resonance Substrate, on the Node Beta board right after the hand-in: the accept hands out nothing; 15 energy crystal bought at Central Nexus from a player's ask of 420 cr (641 at that price, view_market 23:56 UTC), 6,363 cr with the 1% tax; RESULT +589 cr, 8 min. (3) Final Calibration, on the board after Resonance: the accept hands out the 5 circuit boards; delivered at the Node Gamma redock, +8,000 cr; RESULT +7,946 cr, 7 min. The three: +10,847 cr once per pilot in about 37 minutes, nothing left aboard. Each mission left the board after its hand-in. max_pilots 30 since 2026-11-16 03:09 UTC: the Ironlight silver ask stood whole at 152 x 200 in every read (23:21, 00:05, 01:24 and 01:39 UTC) after 20 units were bought about 23:40 and 120 units about 00:30 UTC (ledger.py prices silver_ore; runs.jsonl): it regained at least 120 units within about an hour. So the ask carries at least 34 pilots in four hours (200 standing, at least 120 an hour); 10 traders have flown all three missions (six of them in one run each: +10,893 cr in about 32 minutes, runs.jsonl 00:15 to 00:53 UTC). max_ships 6 keeps a wave at 120 units, under the 200 that stand. Open to every division's plan (queue.log). Stop 1 stores ores and neural soma so nothing of value leaves policed space (orders F13). Trading XP 45 + 30 + 25. 2026-11-16 05:25 UTC: in every plan (orders.log ENT-012); max_pilots 146 (the whole fleet) and max_ships 10. The silver ask at Ironlight regained 120 units within 8 minutes after 200 were bought in ten (books of 04:41:59, 04:58:20 and 05:21:46 UTC: 80, 120, 200 standing) and stands at most at 200: ten ships at a time buy about 375 an hour against at least 900 regained. The energy crystal ask at Central Nexus read 420 cr for 822 at the best level (05:23 UTC), 54 pilots. The runner fault of 01:09 to 04:49 UTC is fixed (requests.log ENT-098).
